items.title: Why deny take out orders and lose business? Help me understand.
items.text:
Why deny take out orders and lose business? Help me understand.
I went to a restaurant tonight I have ordered take out from several times in the past. Normally just walk to the bar order my food then visit a few stores nearby and come back to pick it up when it’s ready. Same routine tonight however after I placed the order the bartender had to check that they are doing take out tonight. My order was 3 items totaling just under $40. He came back and told me they weren’t doing take out due to it being Easter. The restaurant wasn’t overly busy. One large party and a couple of people scattered in the dining room. They didn’t close for a little over an hour. I have never had this problem before and have even ordered closer to the closing window before with no problem. Is this common practice when it is a holiday? I’m kinda stumped why they would deny business just because I am a single person who wants to take his food to go. Any input on the situation is appreciated.

Makes sense they may have had a holiday menu and I can understand why my order could complicate things in the back. The togo thing I don’t kinda get because I may have ordered something they were offering. They didn’t appear busy at least not as busy as they were a couple of hours prior when I drove by. But the limited menu makes sense. Thanks.

UberEats his is to old for. He could do Postmates they don’t care what car you have just that people get what they order. I do it in my spare time let me know if you have more questions or need a referral.

It just takes time. I had a similar mom however when she got off the handle my dad would actually stand up for my sister and I. After my dad died when I was in my early 20’s it got worse because my dad took on most of the family stress and my mom couldn’t handle it and put a lot of it on me.  I moved out a couple of months later. But with new relationships I got into I would almost expect the same reaction when something was wrong and I would turn that person into a version of my mom without realizing it. One day it all clicked why I did that and I sought help. Seek a therapist who has worked with abuse it doesn’t have to be physical abuse. You will learn to think differently. Do I still have low self esteem sure but not as bad as I did.

Had one of these happen to me on Postmates. Tried texting customer couldn’t get out of it. Thank goodness they pay for the wait time and the customer tips after I deliver in this case. Customer felt bad gave me $10 cash tip and tipped $8 in the app. Hope you get a cash tip.

Postmates pay structure to the driver works a little different than other services and no driver is going to deliver it for free. Plus if it was not a partnered restaurant there is no way for them to know if the reorder is placed correctly. Therefore the same situation could happen again. It’s not idiot proof for ordering and pickup like some of the other services. Takes a driver who knows what they are doing to get it right.  Probably why they have you tip after you receive the order not before. Sucks it didn’t give you the result you wanted this time.
